text: The Civic Appointments Committee will conduct interviews and recommend three candidates to City Council for appointment to the Board of Directors of TO Live.

City Council on May 21 and 22, 2025, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following candidates to the Board of Directors of TO Live, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on May 24, 2029, and until successors are appointed: Brett Hendrie Michael Herrera Sammy Lau 2. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1a, 1b and 2 to 4 to the report (April 23, 2025) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Board of Directors of TO Live.
